packageOutline.drawing: SOD27 (DO-35) package outline. The datasheet specifies lead dimensions and length but does not define a fixed board pitch.

padPattern.source: AdigunSimulator CC0 educational defaults. The 7.62 mm pitch is a board-layout convention selected by the application; it is not specified as a manufacturer footprint.

limitations: The 7.62 mm pad center spacing is an application-selected layout convention; axial lead spacing depends on lead forming and is not fixed by the datasheet.
Pad diameter (1.8 mm) and drill (0.8 mm) are application-selected CC0 defaults, not manufacturer land-pattern recommendations.
Pad 1 and pad 2 are application-assigned connection IDs mapped to anode and cathode; the manufacturer does not give physical lead numbers for the axial diode.
Confirm lead forming, cathode-band orientation, finished-hole tolerance, annular ring, and board-fabrication rules before use.
This educational asset has not passed independent physical fit review or manufacturing DRC.
